outcomeClusters.title: Graphing Skills
outcomes: Locate values on the vertical axis that correspond to a value on the horizontal axis.
Identify physical quantities measured on each axis.
Calculate the slope of a graph with numbers and units.
Identify a positive or negative slope by visual inspection.
Calculate the area under the curve of any curve with a constant slope (straight line graphs only).
Add graph segments together to find total area under the curve.
Identify the units on the area under the curve.

outcomeClusters.title: Algebra & Problem Solving
outcomes: Apply algebra to solve for unknown variables symbolically.

outcomeClusters.title: Measurement & Data Analysis
outcomes: Choose appropriate measurement scales and use units in recording.
Identify relationships within variables from data tables.
Differentiate between data sets that are accurate or precise.

outcomeClusters.title: Experimental Design
outcomes: Explain how to read graphs, and identify the experimental vs control groups and variables (independent, dependent, & control).
Distinguish the basic components of experimental design including types of variables, how to read graphs, and the difference between experimental and control groups.

outcomeClusters.title: Units & Prefixes
outcomes: State commonly used units in physics, and what they are used for.
Convert between prefixes from pico to tera.
Identify the SI units for distance, displacement, speed, velocity, acceleration, force, energy, work, power, momentum, impulse, charge, current, voltage, & resistance.
